text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've injured myself. I can<n>only apologize. I
accept full<n>responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know my own body. I felt my limits<n>approaching.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And yet I failed to stop myself in time.<n>I blithely
regarded them as a<n>challenge.
choice_data_list: Let's slow things down for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Quite. Rest assured, I am contrite. If I<n>wish to
conquer myself, first, I must<n>know myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I must learn to walk before I can<n>run. I will bear
that lesson firmly in<n>mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will rise to any challenge that my<n>imperial calling
demands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But for now, I remain constrained.<n>And I admit,
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah. I always end up showing you<n>my worst side,
don't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How am I ever to overcome my limits<n>with a heart
so frail?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, while I cannot train my body for a<n>while, I can
train my mind as I please!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You have opened my eyes, Trainer. I<n>owe you a
debt!
